description: 8sync safety and quality gates (secret/destructive-command guard, verify after edits, stop gate, resume note). Each hook is a no-op when the 8sync binary is missing or when `8sync ccc kit` already registered it in settings.json.

hooks.command: command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin session-start
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin guard
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin verify
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin watchdog
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin verify-stop
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin stop-failure
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin resume-note
command -v 8sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec 8sync ccc hook plugin watchdog
